summary: @ornikar/webpack-config 12.0.4 ships an obfuscated preinstall dropper that fetches the Bun runtime and executes an opaque 727 KB bundled payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs is itself obfuscator.io-style mangled (identifiers like _0x488df8, per-function string dictionaries indirecting paths such as /etc/os-release and URL fragments) and at install time downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it, and invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-line '// @bun @bun-cjs' compiled bundle with rotated string arrays, non-ASCII identifiers, and 'with' statements that block standard deobfuscation. The declared main entrypoint index.js is absent from the tarball, so the package provides none of the advertised webpack-config library surface; the only effect of installing it is execution of the obfuscated Bun payload on the installer's machine. Fetching an alternate language runtime specifically to execute an opaque, obfuscated bundle at preinstall time — in a package whose declared purpose is webpack configuration — is an alternate-runtime dropper, and the use of Bun evades Node-based tarball inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
